newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIA'S PESO FALLS TO HISTORIC LOW VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIA'S PESO FALLS TO HISTORIC LOW VS DLR.

text.p: Colombia's peso dropped 2.8 pesos to an historic low of 1,117.5 against the dollar amid demand for greenbacks from vehicle assemblers coupled with a lack of petro-dollars in the market.
"The rate was highly volatile and it seemed the peso would fall about 3.7 pesos because there were no petro-dollars in the market and banks were left short," one dealer said.
Dealers reported 352 trades worth a total $173.9 million. The peso opened at 1,114 and traded between the intraday high of 1,113.8 and closed at the low.
Thursday is a bank holiday in Colombia and all financial markets and institutions will be closed.
